# Types of loans
## On this page
- [HELP](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans#ato-HELP)
- [VSL](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans#ato-VSL)
- [SFSS](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans#ato-SFSS)
- [SSL and ABSTUDY SSL](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/types-of-loans#ato-SSLandABSTUDYSSL)

## VSL
The VET Student Loans (VSL) program offers protection for students and focuses on courses that address industry needs, creating better opportunities for employment.

VSL offers income contingent loan support to eligible students studying certain diploma level and above vocational education and training qualifications.

For more information, see Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, for:

### VET FEE-HELP (VFH)
Between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2023, people with VFH loans could apply to have their loans re-credited under the VET FEE-HELP Student Redress Measures, in circumstances where their training provider engaged in 'inappropriate conduct.' These measures have now closed.

To understand more about VFH, see Department of Employment and Workplace Relations, for [Information for former VET FEE-HELP studentsExternal Link](https://www.dewr.gov.au/vet-student-loans/vet-information-students/information-former-vet-fee-help-students).

## SFSS
For more information see [Department of Social Services: SFSSExternal Link](http://guides.dss.gov.au/guide-social-security-law/1/2/7/40).

## SSL and ABSTUDY SSL
This is a voluntary loan available to eligible students in higher education who receive:

- Austudy

For more information see Services Australia – [Student Start-up LoanExternal Link](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/individuals/services/centrelink/student-start-loan).

## AASL
Generally, under the Australian Apprenticeship Support Loan (AASL) – previously known as Trade Support Loan (TSL) – program, eligible Australian apprentices are offered loans over a 4-year period.

For more information see [Australian ApprenticeshipsExternal Link](http://www.australianapprenticeships.gov.au/).

web.description:
# Study and training support loans weekly tax table
## Using this tax table
- given you a [Tax file number declaration](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/tfn-declaration) or [Withholding declaration](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/withholding-declaration)
- answered 'yes' to the question on whether they have a
  - Higher Education Loan Program (HELP) debt
  - VET Student Loan (VSL) debt
  - Financial Supplement (FS) debt
  - Student Start-up Loan (SSL) debt (includes ABSTUDY SSL debts)

# Study and training support loans
You can find a number of loans available from the Australian Government to help you complete further training and study.

How to tell your employer about your study or training support loan, and why it's important.

You can make voluntary repayments at any time to help reduce your study or training loan balance.

Provide an overseas travel notification and report your worldwide income if you have a study or training support loan.
